claims: As of late March 2026, the average 30-year fixed mortgage rate is approximately 6.38% to 6.56%
As of late March 2026, the average 30-year fixed mortgage rate marks a four-week increase to the highest level since September 2025
30-year fixed mortgage rates have risen from February lows below 6%
Freddie Mac Weekly Average 30-year fixed mortgage rate for the week of March 29, 2026 is 6.38%
Freddie Mac Weekly Average 30-year fixed mortgage rate the previous week was 6.22%
Bankrate Daily Survey 30-year fixed mortgage rate for the week of March 29, 2026 is 6.56%
Mortgage News Daily 30-year fixed mortgage rate for the week of March 29, 2026 is ~6.64% for top-tier borrowers
The increase in rates has slowed mortgage application demand
Rates are following the 10-year Treasury yield
Some forecasts anticipate rates to hover around 6.1% to 6.3% throughout 2026
The average 30-year refinance rate is roughly 6.78%
